date_note: Herald Business reports the coordination meeting was held on 25 November.
exec: South Korea's trade ministry and other agencies reviewed a draft national industrial technology protection plan due next month, including links to investigation and prosecution.
geo_basis: Meeting at the Government Sejong Complex, per Herald Business
org: Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy (South Korea)
plain: South Korean ministries met to check a draft national plan for protecting industrial technology from leaks. The plan is due to be announced next month, according to Herald Business.
summary: Herald Business reports that South Korea's trade ministry held a policy coordination meeting on 25 November to review departmental tasks in the draft sixth Industrial Technology Protection Master Plan, due to be announced next month. Agencies including the science, finance and intellectual property authorities, police and prosecutors took part. Topics included preventing technology leaks through personnel and where policy connects to investigation and prosecution.
title: South Korea's ministries review draft sixth Industrial Technology Protection Master Plan, Herald Business reports

validation.note: Only Herald Business read; no ministry release was read.
